jobs.title: Sr. Staff Product Manager, Product Experience
jobs.description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You’ll Do**

Product experience is how customers engage with Teradata’s platform. This Sr. Staff PM owns a cross-product charter to improve the quality, consistency, speed, and reach of that experience across the customer journeys and shared capabilities that span our products. You will work with the PMs who own individual product surfaces to set their strategy, and you will make the prioritization calls that cut across product lines. You will partner with UX leaders to shape design direction for shared experiences, and with engineering to deliver them.

* Work with PM for each product surface to set experience strategy and keep it consistent across the portfolio.
* Own the roadmap for shared, cross-product capabilities and customer journeys.
* Set priorities across product teams using clear criteria and record the decisions.
* Define and track activation, adoption, time to value, and retention. Run experiments to test what moves them.
* Find where customers drop off between products and get the owning PMs to fix it.
* Work with design, engineering, docs, and field teams on delivery. You decide what to build and why. They decide how.
* Find places where AI can remove steps from customer workflows.
* Partner with UX leaders and engineering to prioritize and fund a shared pattern library. You set adoption goals and settle trade-offs between product teams. They own the patterns and the components.
* Report progress and risks to senior product leadership.

**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**

* 10+ years in product management, preferably on B2B enterprise data or platform products.
* Experience leading company-wide initiatives across multiple product teams.
* A record of driving adoption and growth with data and experimentation.
* Technical grounding in data platforms and AI.
* Skill at influencing peers and senior leaders without direct authority. Surface PMs keep ownership of their products, so this matters daily.

**What You'll Bring**

* Prior work on products where experience quality set them apart in the market.
* Experience with product-led growth, onboarding, or activation programs.

#LI-PG1

We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.title: Product Manager III, Returns with Amazon
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about building products that customers love? Do you thrive in environments where you can define the vision, rally teams around it, and deliver meaningful results? Amazon is looking for a Product Manager III who combines deep customer understanding with technical curiosity and strong execution skills to own and drive product experiences that matter.  
  
In this role, you will define product strategy, own the roadmap, and collaborate with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners to deliver solutions that create real value for customers and the business. You will operate with significant autonomy, navigating ambiguity to identify the right problems to solve and making smart trade-offs to ship products that delight customers. If you are a self-starter who is energized by turning complex challenges into simple, intuitive experiences, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, making transparent trade-offs to optimize the sequence of deliverables and align stakeholders across engineering, design, marketing, and operations.
* Drive end-to-end product delivery from concept through launch and post-launch optimization, partnering with engineering and design teams on requirements, prototypes, acceptance criteria, and testing.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders, influencing teams with different priorities to align on shared goals and resolve competing perspectives.
* Leverage customer research, usage data, performance metrics, and market trends to inform product decisions, define success criteria and KPIs, and prioritize investments that maximize customer and business impact.
* Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and capabilities where appropriate to accelerate development cycles, improve decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.

  
About the team  
Amazon’s Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce (WWRR) team invents bold solutions in sustainable transportation and returns experiences that create trust and value for customers, selling partners, and shippers and benefit people and the planet. WWRR includes the full complement of business, product, program, operational, data, and software engineering teams, who work together to identify and remove defects that cause returns, reinvent the return experience, and manage the lifecycle of returned, overstock, and damaged products, with the objective of throwing nothing away.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
**Our Company**
---------------

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**The Role**
------------

In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for Teradata Sovereign AI: running AI models on infrastructure the customer controls — on premises or in a private cloud — with the security, governance, and cost control enterprises need to put them into production. Your impact will be measured by customer adoption of on-prem model deployments, the pace and quality of capabilities delivered to market, and the trust you build with engineering, architecture, security, and go-to-market teams. Success looks like a clear, well-sequenced roadmap, customers running production AI workloads on infrastructure they control, and measurable gains in usage and customer satisfaction.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Sovereign AI across three areas:
  + **Security:** model access control, data isolation, protection against prompt injection and data leakage, and a secure model supply chain (provenance, signing, scanning).
  + **Governance:** model registry and lifecycle, policy enforcement, guardrails, audit trails, and compliance with data residency and AI regulation.
  + **Tokenomics:** token usage metering, cost attribution and chargeback by team or use case, quotas, and GPU capacity planning for on-prem deployments.
* Define how customers select, adapt, and run small language models (SLMs) and open-weight models — including fine-tuning, quantization, and routing between SLMs and larger models based on cost and accuracy.
* Build model evaluation into the product: accuracy, safety, latency, and cost benchmarks that customers run on their own data, before and after deployment.
* Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics that give engineering a precise foundation for delivery.
* Drive customer and market discovery — direct customer conversations, competitive analysis, and analyst engagement — with a focus on regulated industries (banking, government, telecom, healthcare) where data cannot leave customer control.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to turn roadmap priorities into a sequenced delivery plan, resolving trade-offs between scope, performance, and timeline.
* Work with Go-to-Market, Pricing, and Customer Success on positioning, packaging, pricing, and enablement.
* Track product health — adoption, model quality, cost per use case, customer satisfaction — and use it to steer the roadmap.
* Represent Sovereign AI in cross-product planning to keep it aligned with the AI & Data Platform roadmap.
* Guide and review the work of associate and senior product managers contributing to the roadmap.

**Who You'll Work With**
------------------------

This role sits within Teradata's AI Platform product organization and reports to the Senior Director of Product Management for AI. You'll work closely with the engineering and architecture teams building model serving, security, and governance capabilities, and with product managers across adjacent AI and platform areas to keep priorities aligned. You'll partner regularly with Security, Legal and Compliance, Go-to-Market, Pricing, and Customer Success to turn the roadmap into a strong customer and field experience. This is an individual product leadership role with the opportunity to shape how Teradata delivers AI that customers fully control.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
----------------------------------------

### **Required**

* 10+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with enterprise AI/ML platforms, data platforms, or infrastructure software.
* Demonstrated experience owning a product area end to end — from discovery and strategy through delivery and post-launch iteration.
* Working knowledge of how language models are served on private infrastructure: inference servers (e.g., vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Triton), GPU resource management, and Kubernetes.
* Experience with enterprise security and governance requirements: identity and access management, encryption, audit, and data residency.
* Experience writing strategy and vision documents (e.g., PRFAQs), PRDs, user stories, and measurable success criteria that engineering teams can execute against.
* Experience partnering directly with engineering and architecture teams in enterprise software.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with SLMs and open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Phi, Gemma, Qwen), including fine-tuning, distillation, or quantization.
* Experience designing or running model evaluations: benchmarks, LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, and tools such as lm-evaluation-harness, Ragas, or DeepEval.
* Experience with usage metering, cost attribution, or pricing for AI or cloud services.
* Experience delivering sovereign cloud or air-gapped deployments for government or regulated industries.
* MBA or advanced technical degree.

About the Company

Giridhari Homes is a Hyderabad-based real estate development company focused on delivering premium residential apartments, gated communities, luxury developments, golf-county projects and riverfront high-rises.

With a diverse portfolio comprising 24 Carat, Happiness Hub, Vue and Haldi Golf County, along with upcoming premium residential developments, the company is focused on expanding its market presence and delivering exceptional residential experiences.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, dynamic and result-oriented Sales Head to lead and oversee the entire residential sales division of Giridhari Homes.

The candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, developing sales strategies, managing project-wise sales performance, building high-performing sales teams and expanding the company’s channel partner network.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership capabilities, extensive knowledge of the Hyderabad real estate market and a proven track record of achieving high-value sales targets.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

1. Sales Strategy and Revenue Management

\* Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies across all existing and upcoming residential projects.

\* Take complete ownership of monthly, quarterly and annual sales and revenue targets.

\* Establish project-wise and individual sales targets for the sales team.

\* Develop strategies to accelerate sales velocity and optimise inventory liquidation.

\* Work closely with management on pricing strategies, payment plans, promotional offers and project positioning.

\* Identify new business opportunities and revenue-generating avenues.

2. Sales Team Leadership and Management

\* Lead, manage and monitor sales managers, site sales teams, relationship managers and channel partner teams across projects.

\* Recruit, train, mentor and develop a high-performing sales team.

\* Conduct daily sales reviews and weekly and monthly performance evaluations.

\* Establish clear KPIs, accountability systems and performance benchmarks.

\* Develop effective sales processes and ensure consistent implementation across all project sites.

\* Personally participate in high-value negotiations and critical sales closures.

3. Channel Partner and Business Development

\* Build, strengthen and expand the company’s channel partner and broker network.

\* Develop relationships with HNI, UHNI and NRI customers.

\* Establish corporate tie-ups and strategic business partnerships.

\* Identify and pursue bulk sales and institutional sales opportunities.

\* Monitor channel partner productivity, engagement and revenue contribution.

\* Organise channel partner meetings, project presentations and sales events.

4. Lead Management and Sales Conversion

\* Coordinate closely with the marketing department to improve lead quality and conversion rates.

\* Monitor the complete sales funnel, from initial enquiry and site visit to negotiation and booking.

\* Ensure timely follow-ups and effective customer engagement by the sales team.

\* Analyse lead sources, conversion ratios, lost opportunities and customer feedback.

\* Ensure accurate and timely updates of all sales activities in the CRM system.

\* Develop strategies to maximise conversions and minimise lead leakage.

5. Project Launches and Market Intelligence

\* Plan and execute sales strategies for new project launches and pre-launch campaigns.

\* Conduct regular market research and competitor analysis.

\* Monitor market trends, customer preferences, competitor pricing and emerging opportunities.

\* Provide strategic recommendations to management regarding pricing, product positioning and sales potential.

\* Coordinate with marketing teams for promotional campaigns, property exhibitions and customer engagement initiatives.

6. Customer Relationship and Interdepartmental Coordination

\* Ensure a premium customer experience throughout the sales journey.

\* Handle escalated customer concerns and complex sales negotiations.

\* Coordinate with CRM, accounts, finance, legal and project teams for seamless customer onboarding.

\* Monitor booking confirmations, payment commitments, cancellations and outstanding collections in coordination with the CRM department.

\* Ensure proper documentation and smooth handover of customers from sales to CRM.

\* Maintain strong customer relationships to generate referrals and repeat business.

**JobSummary:**

  

Bonterra is looking for an AI-first Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and ship software by orchestrating AI coding agents across the full development lifecycle. This role is intentionally language and stack agnostic: rather than being defined by expertise in a single programming language, the ideal candidate uses AI tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to work productively across whatever languages, frameworks, and systems a given team needs, from backend services and APIs to front-end applications, data pipelines, and infrastructure automation. You will take ownership of complex technical problems end to end, using AI as a force multiplier for planning, implementation, testing, and review, while retaining full engineering accountability for the quality, security, and reliability of everything you and your agents ship.

  

**AI-ORCHESTRATED SOFTWARE DELIVERY (45%)**

  

* Designs, builds, tests, and ships production-quality features and services end to end, using AI coding agents to plan, scaffold, implement, and validate work throughout the development lifecycle.
* Breaks product and technical requirements into discrete units of work that can be delegated to, or executed in partnership with, AI agents, then reviews and refines the resulting output for correctness, security, and maintainability before it reaches production.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION (15%)**

* Stays current on emerging AI coding assistants, agent-orchestration frameworks, and related tooling, proactively evaluating and recommending tools that improve team velocity and quality.
* Identifies opportunities to automate manual engineering or operational workflows using AI and agentic approaches.

  

**KEY BEHAVIORS -- THE "HOW"**

  

* Treats AI agents as force multipliers while maintaining full accountability for the quality, security, and correctness of anything shipped to production, whether written by a human or an agent.
* Demonstrates a bias to action and comfort with ambiguity, iterating quickly while still applying sound engineering judgment.

**OUTCOME EXPECTATIONS -- THE "IMPACT"**

  

* Ships secure, reliable, production-quality software faster by effectively orchestrating AI coding agents across the development lifecycle.
* Reduces manual engineering and operational toil through automation and thoughtful tooling choices.
* Delivers on product and technical requirements regardless of the underlying programming language or technology stack.
* Elevates the quality and velocity of the broader engineering team through mentorship, code review, and shared AI-assisted best practices

**Required Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? Amazon is looking for a Process Improvement Specialist to join our EU FBA Support Operations team, where you will identify opportunities to enhance workflows, reduce waste, and drive meaningful results. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners to build and implement solutions that directly impact team performance and the associate experience.  
  
You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.  
  
A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.  
  
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
* Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
* Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.
* Monitor system performance and service levels through defined metrics, using findings to refine processes and sustain long-term operational gains.

* Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
* Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
* Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
* Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions

A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their work between identifying process gaps, performing execution support, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods. Additionally, you might start your morning reviewing performance dashboards to spot trends or anomalies in s key metrics. From there, you could spend time on observing a workflow firsthand, gathering input to engage directly with stakeholders, sellers and and manage what is working and what could be better. You might draft a new procedure based on your findings, coordinate with a partner team on an upcoming rollout, or present a recommendation to leadership. You will balance hands-on problem-solving with clear documentation and communication throughout the day.

Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years.  
  
Our team is dedicated to making Amazon's fulfillment operations as efficient and reliable as possible. We focus on identifying what can be improved across processes, tools, and systems, then work together to turn those ideas into action. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do, and we partner closely with operations, learning, and technology teams to deliver results that matter.  
  
We are building an inclusive environment where new ideas are welcomed and every team member has the opportunity to grow. If you are looking for a role where your analytical skills and initiative can make a real, measurable impact, this is the team for you.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  

* Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
* Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
* Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
* Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved

* Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area

  
About the team  
In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.  
  
WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.  
  
Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

------------------------

* 2+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
* 2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Digital Human Health (DHH)**
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
  
  
Within DHH, the Content Creation & Storage pillar of Digital Content & Customer Experience (DCCE) builds the platforms and capabilities that help Human Health create compliant, on-brand content faster. As part of the Content Accelerator, the pillar is moving content creation from manual production to AI-generated content that is built to brand and compliance standards from the start, combining agentic content creation platform (Content Studio), Adobe capabilities, and the design system.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
Own business analysis for Content Studio, AI-enabled content creation capability. Turn business needs into clear, build-ready, and traceable requirements, and work hands-on alongside engineering, UX, and implementation partners from discovery through release.
  
  
The role is the Product Owner’s day-to-day partner. As the person grows, they will be expected to take on product ownership for defined Content Studio features or components, including backlog decisions, stakeholder alignment, and release outcomes.
  
  
Scope of Ownership & Adjacent Responsibilities
  
  
***Accountable for (owns the deliverable and its quality)***

* Content Studio requirements functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for assigned features and components.
* Backlog readiness stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready before sprint planning.
* The product source of truth (Confluence/JIRA) workflows, business rules, input/output requirements, integrations, known limitations, and the decision log.
* Requirements traceability from business need to story, test, and released functionality.
* UAT coordination with business users, including tracking feedback and gaps through to closure.
* The user feedback loop capturing feedback from content creators, brand teams, and reviewers, and turning it into prioritized backlog items.

***Partners on (contributes; another role makes the final decision)***

* Backlog prioritization and release scope, with the Product Owner.
* Solution design and technical approach, with engineering and implementation partners.
* Integration requirements with adjacent platforms (e.g., Adobe capabilities, design system, guardrails/rules engine, Veeva Vault PromoMats), with the respective product teams.

***Adjacent***

* Flex across other Content Creation & Storage workstreams (e.g., Adobe Brand Intelligence experiments, design system) as priorities shift.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Requirements & Backlog Ownership
  
  

* Run discovery with business users to understand workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes before writing requirements.
* Write user stories with clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and dependencies, and resolve open questions before development starts.
* Prepare refinement and sprint planning with the Product Owner. Bring a ready, sized backlog and a recommended priority order.
* Turn workflows into clear product behavior, including user flows, error handling, and human-in-the-loop review points.
* Manage requirement changes and log scope decisions so everyone knows what changed and why.

Working with Tech Teams & Validation
  
  

* Work closely with engineering during sprints to clarify requirements and resolve open questions quickly.
* Get hands-on with Content Studio’s AI features (e.g., prompts, agent inputs/outputs, brand rules) to understand how they behave and confirm they meet requirements.
* Build a working understanding of the platform’s architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and partners.
* Coordinate UAT with business users, capturing feedback, defects, and gaps and following them through to resolution.

Documentation, Governance & Communication
  
  

* Keep the Content Studio source of truth current and easy to understand for new team members, business users, engineers, and partners.
* Maintain the decision log, open questions, risks, and dependencies across internal and partner teams.
* Build compliance into requirements, including human-in-the-loop controls, AI labeling, auditability, and alignment with AI and content policies.
* Share concise updates on progress, decisions, risks, and releases with the Product Owner and stakeholders.

Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration
  
  

* Facilitate requirement workshops and working sessions that end in clear decisions and owners.
* Review vendor and partner solutions against documented requirements, and raise gaps early.
* Act as the bridge between business and technical teams so both share the same understanding of what is being built and why.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Stories reach sprint planning ready to build, with little rework or mid-sprint clarification.
* Content Studio has one current, trusted source of truth that engineers, partners, and new joiners actually use.
* Every released feature can be traced back to a business need and an agreed acceptance test.
* Delivered features match what the business asked for, with gaps caught early through UAT.
* User feedback is turned into prioritized improvements quickly and visibly.
* Over time, the person independently owns defined features or components end to end, showing readiness for a Product Owner role.

**Qualifications & Experience**
Education
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* 4–5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Product Owner/Manager in dig…

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Technical Product Manager – Global Healthcare Exchange (GHXI)**
**Role Overview**

* Hands-on, individual contributor role focused on driving product delivery that aligns with customer needs and strategic business objectives.
* Build a deep understanding of GHX products and the customer journey across supported ERP systems.
* Act as the key link between engineering, customers, and business teams, working closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, and end users.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable tasks for engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess ERP opportunities and customer needs to build business cases and product roadmaps.
* Convert business needs and customer feedback on ERP integrations into clear product requirements, broken down into releases, epics, and user stories.
* Write user persona scenarios that illustrate B2B market problems and justify why a requirement is needed.
* Work with engineering and cross-functional teams to align on scope, effort estimates, and release timelines.
* Explore integration options with various ERP and MMIS systems, partnering with internal teams and external ERP business partners to deliver an optimal customer experience between GHX products and ERP platforms.
* Hold regular checkpoints with development, customers, and business stakeholders to ensure timely, high-quality integration delivery.
* Identify and communicate risks and issues, and propose mitigation plans.
* Stay current with industry trends, ERP platform changes, and best practices in integration design and architecture.
* Support business and customer success teams with product expertise and technical guidance.
* Define and track KPIs to measure integration effectiveness, user adoption, and customer satisfaction, driving continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with other Technical Product Managers overseeing ERP integrations to share knowledge, align roadmaps, and prioritize work for engineering.

**Key Competencies**

* Collaborative team player with a strong technical mindset and attention to detail.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to resolve conflicts and manage differing viewpoints.
* Skilled in risk assessment, prioritization, and mitigation planning.
* Excellent communication skills with both internal and external customers.
* Experience leading meetings, setting agendas, driving decisions, and negotiating.
* Ability to navigate complex relationships and balance stakeholder interests to achieve results.

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years of professional experience with technical products, preferably with a B2B integrations background.
* Experience communicating technical solutions to internal and external audiences.
* Mandatory: experience in ERP integration or B2B integrations.
* Self-directed, with strong initiative and organizational skills.
* Sound technical product management skills and a customer-focused mindset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across multiple business and technical functions.
* Certifications in relevant product management and Agile methodologies.

**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
  
  
GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
  
  
It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
You are accountable within a project to drive the specifications to conclusions. You are accountable for getting a sign off on the Business Specification Document (BSD). With your input the Engineering manager will start delivering a working system for the customer. You closely work together with the Engineering Manager.
  
  
You lead complex engagements. You are the customer's trusted advisor in creating clarity on the full requirements set for the program. This also is towards the backbase team. You act as an experienced Backbase consultant to clients.
  
  
Based on the defined strategy from the bank and the goal of the program, your job is to proactively support the customer on creating and implementing their omni-channel digital banking transformation vision and strategy.
  
  
You clearly communicate progress, risks, blockers, and dependencies with the core team. You are an experienced consultant who analyzes, captures, and prioritizes customer requirements, identifies product improvements, and defines best practices.
  
  
As a person you are organised, have oversight, know how to finish a job without loose ends and are used to working in a fixed date environment.
  
  
You manage the process of feature requests and maints with PnP.
  
  
**Result Driven**

* Leads the business requirements gathering and completing the specs. He/she owns this full for the project.
* Accountability for the end-to-end quality of functional and technical specifications, including the alignment of UX and Solution Architecture within the signed-off BSD.
* Accountable for thorough and accurate project backlog management in Jira, including scope definition and backlog quality.
* Accountable for creating and signing off on BSD plus managing the CR process that comes out of this. Accountable for writing and organizing user stories and epics, feature requests, and MAINTS (product bug reports).
* Coaching / instructing formatting to others, and ensuring a signed-off Business Specification Document (BSD)/Project Config Sheet.
* Uses AI in a meaningful way to speed up the process. Knows for example how to translate AI generated notes and recordings into specs.
* Capable of giving a Demo on the Backbase Product.

**Communication Skills**

* Manages customer expectations, works closely with customers, and leads engaging workshops.

**Product Knowledge**

* Provides guidance to clients on the best usage of the product as well as customization. Works with Backbase R&D colleagues where customization is necessary to explore out-of-the-box options or recommend enhancements.

**Problem-solving & Analytical Skills**

* Is able to create BSD’s independently.
* Industry knowledge & Business Value:
* Defines essential requirements for customers to achieve their objectives and realize their customer experience vision within the financial industry context.
* Quantifies the value for the customer between solving something in adopt vs build. And takes into account items that may speed up requirements gathering and or development.

**Adaptability**

* Translates customer vision into a sound project backlog and explores out-of-the-box options versus recommended enhancements.
* Strategically applies AI tools across complex business analysis initiatives in order to improve documentation and solution quality, while continuously adapting approaches in a dynamic and fast-changing environment.
* Understanding the Agentic SDLC and how the flows improve month after month.

Creativity
  
  

* Identifies product improvements and defines best practices.

**Leadership Skills**

* Guides the team, acts as the customer’s proxy product owner, and provides some amount of mentoring to Junior Business Analysts.
* Experience: 3-7 years in a similar role.
* Backbase/Banking Experience: 1+ year in Backbase; 3-4 years in Banking or Financial services.
* Domain Knowledge: Seen by their peers as an expert with deep knowledge and understanding of at least one Backbase Line of Business (LOB)
* Methodology: Expert in creating Business Specification Documents (BSD), Epics, User stories and BE tasks. Knowledge of Backbase way of working (delivery hub) and fluent working with our Agentic SDLC.
* Tooling: Expert in Jira, Gemini (or similar LLM), Google sheets / slides and workshopping tools like Miro. Has AI as a default way of working.
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree or higher; IIBA CCB certification.
* Language: Professional working proficiency in English and local language.
* Travel: Willingness to travel according to project need and demand.

jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

As a
**(Senior) Business Analyst**
within HEINEKEN’s D&A Product Organisation, you play a pivotal role in turning the Smart Brewery vision into reality. Embedded in a cross functional product squad (Packaging, Brewing or Utilities), receiving
**functional direction, backlog prioritisation, and product vision from the Product Lead**
, who acts as the squad’s proxyProduct Owner. You act as the connector between business needs and digital solutions — ensuring our products solve real operational problems and deliver measurable value.

You work closely with Product Leads, Data Engineers, Developers, UX Designers and brewery stakeholders to translate operational challenges into clear requirements, structured use cases, and scalable global D&A products. Through strong analytical thinking, structured facilitation, and user centric design, you ensure each increment contributes to more efficient, sustainable, and data driven brewery operations.

A key part of your role is to reinforce
**Agile Ways of Working**
— shaping the backlog, breaking down needs into refined user stories, validating sprint outcomes, and driving continuous improvement. You also help curate the global usecase portfolio through evaluation, refinement, and prioritisation of ideas.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Discovery & Requirements**

* Translate business needs into clear
  **epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria**
  , and process flows
  **under the functional guidance of the Product Lead**
  .
* Shape and maintain
  **global, scalable use cases**
  aligned with the D&A roadmap.
* Support the Product Lead with use case definition, scoping, and prioritisation with use case owners, global and regional.
* Validate feasibility, data needs, and technical implications with the development team.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems, clarifying the underlying “why” behind requests.
* Evaluate new ideas through the
  **Idea Portal**
  , ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

**2. Stakeholder Engagement**

* Bridge business and technical perspectives through clear, structured communication.
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and alignment sessions to ensure shared understanding.
* Collaborate with global/regional SMEs, breweries, and development teams to verify value and relevance.
* Act as the
  **voice of the user**
  , ensuring solutions meet real operational needs.

**3. Data & Analytics Enablement**

* Analyse data sources to support KPI definitions, modelling logic, and dashboard requirements.
* Identify data quality and structural gaps; collaborate with data engineers to resolve issues.
* Support the creation of dashboards, monitoring tools, and analytical solutions.
* Ensure consistent business logic and KPI definitions across global use cases.

**4. Product Delivery & Value Realisation**

* Provide ongoing clarification of requirements during sprints.
* Conduct functional testing, data validation, and quality checks to ensure increments meet user expectations.
* Validate outputs during demos and ensure feedback loops drive continuous improvement.
* Support adoption measurement, performance monitoring, and value tracking in breweries.
* Assess and prioritise enhancement requests using the Idea Portal and demand management processes.

**5. Supporting Agile Ways of Working**

* Break down objectives into structured backlog items that meet the
  **Definition of Ready**
  .
* Actively contribute to Agile ceremonies:
* **Sprint Planning:**
  provide context and support scope decisions
* **Refinement:**
  bring clarity, structure, and alignment
* **Daily Collaboration:**
  support real‑time clarifications
* **Reviews:**
  validate increments and facilitate feedback
* **Retrospectives:**
  champion continuous improvement
* Promote iterative, value driven delivery — starting small, validating early, learning fast.

**6. Change & Adoption**

* Support rollout activities through documentation, training materials, and deployment guidance.
* Ensure new features, use cases, and tools are understood, adopted, and delivering value across breweries.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics or related field.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments; Agile certifications are a strong plus.

**Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

* Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
* Proven ability to translate business challenges into actionable requirements.
* Strong understanding of analytics concepts (KPIs, modelling, data flows).
* Familiarity with tools like Power BI and/or Grafana (or willingness to learn).
* Strong analytical and structured problem solving skills.
* Experience working in global, cross cultural environments.
* Fluent English (written & spoken).

**Desirable**

* Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, or industrial analytics.
* Exposure to OT/IT integration (MES, SCADA, sensors) or similar environments.

**Mindset & Behaviours**

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
MediaMint is an AI-powered Revenue Operations services company dedicated to accelerating innovation and revenue growth for platforms and publishers worldwide. Our mission is to enhance operational efficiency, scalability, customer satisfaction, and data-driven insights through advanced technology, automation, and AI capabilities. We serve industry leaders across AdTech, Consumer, CTV, Publishing, and Retail.

**Job Description:**

Mia is MediaMint's agentic AI platform for digital media operations. AI agents built on Mia support workflows across media operations, yield, sales and marketing. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who wants to turn proven AI solutions into products. As Mia scales, we are turning client solutions into ready-to-use agents in the Mia agent library. You will work with our solutions, engineering, platform and delivery teams to shape agents that can be demonstrated quickly, configured for a new client rather than rebuilt, and measured once they are live. The goal is faster client onboarding, shorter sales cycles and agents whose impact can be shown with data.

You will lead the decision on what should be reusable, working with solutions and engineering, write the requirements the team builds from, and own the product after it ships.

**What You Do:**

**Turn Client Solutions into Products**

● Join client discovery and solution discussions, and identify what can be reused, what should be configurable, and what is truly custom.

● Write clear product requirements: the problem, the users, the workflow, the points where a human reviews the agents work, and the acceptance criteria.

● Define acceptance criteria and confirm they are met before release.

**Build for Reuse**

● Define which capabilities should be shared across agents, and work with the platform team to make them reusable, so that a new client or a new data source is a configuration change rather than a new build.

● Define the product standard for the agents you own, working with the platform team that owns the agent library.

**Package and Launch**

● Package each agent with a default setup, an onboarding checklist, a working demo and clear documentation.

● Reduce the time it takes to demonstrate an agent to a prospect and to onboard a new client.

● Support pricing and packaging decisions with usage and cost data.

**Measure What Works**

● Define what your agents should report: usage, success and failure, human corrections, and cost.

● Partner with engineering to get this instrumented and visible in dashboards.

● Use the data to show the impact of your agents and to decide what to improve next, working with customer success, who own client-level adoption reporting.

**Partner Across Functions**

● Work closely with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Implementation, Customer Success and Sales.

● Make sure every agent has a demo that a sales team can run on its own.

● Keep track of competing AI agent products and bring what you learn into product decisions.

**Must-Have Skills:**

● 4 to 7 years in B2B product, solutions or implementation roles, with at least 2 years as a

product manager or product owner, and a track record of turning custom client work into a reusable product, feature or process, with measurable results.

● Ability to map a multi-step workflow and write requirements that engineers can build from.

● Comfort with data: you define metrics, work with engineering on instrumentation, and use dashboards to make decisions.

● Experience in AdTech, media operations, marketing technology or sales technology.

● Strong product judgment, and the communication skills to hold a position with senior stakeholders and clients.

**Good-to-Have / Bonus Skills:**

● Experience with AI-native, agentic, LLM, copilot or workflow-automation products: a strong differentiator, not a requirement.

● Experience with advertising or marketing platform integrations and APIs.

● Hands-on use of a product analytics or monitoring tool such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or New Relic.

● Experience measuring AI output quality, task success or human-in-the-loop review.

● Programmatic, yield or publisher-side experience.

● Experience running user acceptance testing and product releases.

● Working SQL for your own analysis.

**Position Description:**   

Company Profile:  
.  
   
Job Title: Senior Applied AI Engineer  
Experience: 6-12 yrs  
Category: IT  
Main location: Hyderabad

Job Description Summary  
 You will design, build and operate production grade AI agents that talk to real customers. Working on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, you will own the reasoning, retrieval, tooling and guardrails behind services handling millions of conversations. This is applied AI engineering, taking systems from prototype to reliable, evaluated, governed production, not research.  
   
 Client , Technology is a core driver of how we deliver our strategy. You'll join a team modernising our platforms, strengthening cyber and operational resilience, and advancing a product led way of working that brings engineers, data specialists and business experts together to deliver meaningful outcomes at pace.  
 We're scaling automation and AI from proof of concept into real, end to end change, improving customer journeys, reducing cost to serve, accelerating delivery, and building the digital foundations that underpin everything from energy trading and risk to field operations and critical infrastructure.  
 If you want to work on complex, high impact problems using modern engineering practices, and help build reusable platforms that will shape how Client operates over the next decade, this is the place to do it.  
   
 An opportunity to play your part. You will join the Channel Platforms team, which owns Client 's customer conversation estate across voice, chat and email. Our agents are already live: a pay as you go voice assistant built on a real time speech to speech model, a multi channel customer facing agent spanning voice, chat and WhatsApp, and a standalone agentic webchat service running on AgentCore Runtime.  
   
 As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will own the intelligence layer of these products. That means the agent's reasoning and orchestration, the tools it can call, the knowledge it retrieves, the guardrails that constrain it, and the evaluation that proves it works. You will decide what good looks like and then build the measurement to show whether we are hitting it.  
 This is a role for someone who has taken generative AI past the demo stage. Our problems are the hard ones that show up after launch: grounding answers in the right source, keeping voice latency low enough to feel natural, handing off to a human at the right moment, and proving to a goverce board that the system behaves safely at scale.  
 You do not need a contact centre background. If you are a strong engineer who has built real agentic systems on Bedrock or a comparable platform, we will teach you the domain.  
Location: UK based hybrid role, occasional travel to site.  
 Day to day  
   
 . Design and build agentic services on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, including multi step orchestration, state and memory management, and graceful handling of failure and ambiguity.  
 . Build and own the tool layer that agents act through, exposing business capability such as account lookup, billing and identity as reliable, well described actions with sensible error semantics.  
 . Build retrieval augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases, taking ownership of content preparation, chunking, embedding strategy, retrieval quality and answer grounding.  
 . Treat prompts as engineering artefacts. Version them, test them, and understand precisely what changed when behaviour shifts.  
 . Build the evaluation harness. Define what accuracy, containment and safe behaviour mean for each product, assemble regression sets, and make it possible to ship a prompt or model change with evidence rather than optimism.  
 . Implement guardrails and safety controls, including PII handling, out of scope refusal, jailbreak resistance and clean escalation to a human advisor.  
 . Engineer for latency and cost. Streaming, model selection and routing, caching and token budgets all matter, and in voice they matter in real time where a pause of a few hundred milliseconds is felt by the customer.  
 . Instrument agent behaviour end to end so that tool failures, retrieval misses and abandoned conversations are visible in Datadog and QuickSight, not discovered through complaints.  
 . Support live AI services in production, investigating incidents and diagnosing non deterministic behaviour, then closing the loop with permanent fixes.  
 . Make and document build versus buy calls, writing Architecture Decision Records and taking designs through our AI goverce board and change control process.  
 . Track how the generative AI landscape is moving and bring the parts that deliver clear benefit into the roadmap, with an honest read on the risk as well as the upside.  
   
 What we need from you  
 Essential:  
   
 . Substantial software engineering experience, with strong Python. You write production code, not just notebooks.  
 . Demonstrable delivery of LLM or agentic systems into production for real users, and the scar tissue that comes with it. We will ask what broke and what you changed.  
 . Hands on experience with tool and function calling, multi step agent orchestration, and managing conversational state across turns.  
 . Production experience with retrieval augmented generation, including retrieval quality evaluation and answer grounding, not just wiring up a vector store.

 . Experience deploying and operating AI services in the cloud using serverless or container based architectures, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and CI/CD.

jobs.description:
**Dear Candidate,**

**Greetings of the day!!**

  

**If you're looking for a job change in Delivery/ Lead Product Owner**

  

**Please share below details to MP00834258@TECHMAHINDRA.COM \**

  

**Please do refer if you have any friends for this role.**

  

**JD:**

  

**Job Description Lead Product Owner (LPO) – Fixed Network Automation (FNA)**

**Role Purpose**

The **Lead Product Owner (LPO) – Fixed Network Automation** is accountable for defining the product vision, strategic roadmap, investment priorities, demand management, and delivery outcomes for Fixed Network Automation capabilities. The role acts as the primary bridge between business stakeholders, architecture, operations, vendors, and agile delivery teams to drive automation, operational efficiency, network transformation, and value realization.

The LPO owns the end-to-end lifecycle from demand intake through planning, design, build, migration, operationalization, and benefit realization while ensuring alignment to business strategy, governance, and financial objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Demand & Strategic Planning**

* Own and govern the FNA demand pipeline.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, strategic alignment, customer impact, and ROI.
* Develop and maintain multi-year product roadmaps.
* Align automation initiatives with OSS, Fixed Network, and enterprise transformation strategies.
* Drive investment case creation and business case prioritization.
* Lead quarterly and annual planning activities.

**2. Capacity Management**

* Establish demand versus capacity planning across squads.
* Monitor workforce utilization, vendor capacity, and delivery throughput.
* Assess future capability requirements and resource demand.
* Optimize squad structure to support strategic delivery commitments.
* Drive data-driven decisions on hiring, vendor engagement, and automation opportunities.

**3. Requirements Management**

* Own product backlog and prioritization.
* Translate business objectives into epics, features, and user stories.
* Ensure clear acceptance criteria and business outcomes are defined.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops and requirement discovery sessions.
* Manage requirement traceability from concept through deployment.

**4. Design & Build**

* Provide business leadership across solution design and development activities.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Solution Designers, and Tech Leads.
* Ensure solutions adhere to target architecture and automation standards.
* Drive agile delivery across sprint and PI planning cycles.
* Govern delivery milestones and product quality.

**5. Transformation & Migration**

* Lead legacy platform transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Drive migration roadmaps from legacy OSS systems to strategic platforms.
* Manage business readiness, transition planning, and adoption activities.
* Identify and mitigate migration risks and dependencies.
* Ensure operational continuity during transformation programs.

**6. Inventory & Asset Management**

* Provide product ownership for network inventory and asset management capabilities.
* Ensure accuracy, availability, and integrity of network inventory data.
* Drive inventory data quality improvement initiatives.
* Support inventory transformation and data governance programmes.
* Align inventory capabilities with automation and orchestration objectives.

**7. Network Automation**

* Define automation strategy for fixed networks.
* Identify automation opportunities across fulfilment, assurance, inventory, planning, and operations.
* Drive adoption of AI, workflow automation, orchestration, and self-healing capabilities.
* Monitor automation benefits and realization against target outcomes.
* Champion continuous improvement and innovation.

**8. Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with business stakeholders, operations, architecture, and suppliers.
* Act as primary escalation point for product and delivery issues.
* Communicate roadmap, priorities, risks, and delivery status to leadership.
* Drive alignment across multiple delivery teams and external vendors.

**9. Financial & Governance Management**

* Own product investment roadmap and financial planning.
* Support business case development and governance approvals.
* Manage budget, forecasts, risks, opportunities, and benefits realization.
* Ensure compliance with commercial and delivery governance processes.

**Required Domain Knowledge**

**Essential**

* Fixed Network OSS
* Network Automation
* Inventory & Asset Management
* Demand & Capacity Management
* Product Ownership & Agile Delivery
* Requirements Engineering
* Transformation & Migration Programs
* Design & Build Lifecycle Management
* Portfolio & Roadmap Planning
* Financial Governance & Business Cases

**Experience**

* 12+ years in Telecom OSS and Network Transformation.
* 5+ years as Product Owner, Platform Owner, Delivery Lead, or Transformation Lead.
* Proven experience in Fixed Network Automation and OSS transformation programs.
* Experience managing large-scale delivery portfolios and vendor ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of Agile, SAFe, and Product Operating Models.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack Developer)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Full Stack Developer** with hands-on experience in **Angular, Java, Spring Boot, and relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL**. The candidate should be capable of developing responsive, accessible frontend applications, building backend services and REST APIs, and integrating applications with databases. You'll work across the full application development lifecycle, including frontend development, backend logic, API integration, database operations, testing, debugging, and maintaining existing applications. You'll collaborate closely with UX/UI designers, QA, product owners, and other engineers to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable applications.

  

**What Youll Do**

* Build responsive web applications using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Develop backend services, business logic, and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful APIs for application functionality.
* Connect frontend components with backend services and handle API responses.
* Design, write, and maintain SQL queries for application data.
* Work with relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL.
* Implement CRUD operations and manage data interactions between application services and databases.
* Troubleshoot and debug frontend, backend, API, and database issues.
* Develop reusable, maintainable, and efficient code following team standards.
* Follow secure coding practices and application development guidelines.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and maintenance of existing applications.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, product owners, and other stakeholders.
* Follow Agile/Scrum practices and team development processes.

  

**Required Technical Skills**

**Front-End Development**

* Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
* Responsive design using CSS Flexbox and Grid.
* Experience building and maintaining user interfaces for web applications.

**Angular**

* Hands-on knowledge of a recent Angular version (v16 or later).
* Understanding of components, services, dependency injection, routing, and modules.
* Experience with template-driven and reactive forms.
* Understanding of Angular lifecycle hooks.
* Familiarity with RxJS, Observables, and asynchronous operations.
* Ability to integrate Angular applications with REST APIs.

  

**Backend Development Java**

* Hands-on experience with Java Version 21.
* Strong understanding of Java programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming (OOP).
* Knowledge of classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, and encapsulation.
* Understanding of collections, exception handling, and basic multithreading concepts.
* Ability to develop backend logic and business functionality using Java.
* Familiarity with debugging and troubleshooting Java applications.

  

**Spring Boot**

* Hands-on knowledge of Spring Boot application development.
* Understanding of RESTful web services and API development.
* Familiarity with Spring MVC, dependency injection, and application configuration.
* Understanding of request handling, response generation, and backend processing.
* Experience integrating backend services with databases.
* Familiarity with exception handling, validation, and API testing.

  

**Database MySQL & PostgreSQL**

* Working knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL.
* Strong understanding of SQL queries, including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE.
* Knowledge of joins, subqueries, aggregate functions, and filtering.
* Understanding of tables, relationships, primary keys, and foreign keys.
* Familiarity with CRUD operations and database integration with backend applications.
* Basic understanding of database design and query optimization.

  

**Web Accessibility**

* Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 Level AA, including the four principles: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust (POUR).
* Understanding of Section 508 and ADA requirements for web applications.
* Semantic HTML5 and correct use of ARIA roles, states, and properties.
* Keyboard accessibility, logical tab order, visible focus, and focus management.
* Accessible forms, color contrast, and text alternatives for images and icons.
* Familiarity with screen reader testing and accessibility tools such as axe DevTools, WAVE, or Lighthouse.

  

**Tools and Integration**

* Understanding of REST APIs and JSON.
* Basic Git (clone, branch, commit, pull requests).
* Comfortable using development and browser tools for debugging.
* Familiarity with Maven or Gradle.
* Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman.

  

**Additional Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Angular Material or other UI component libraries.
* Unit testing basics (Jasmine, Karma, Jest, or JUnit).
* Exposure to Spring Data JPA or Hibernate.
* Familiarity with ORM concepts and database connectivity.
* Awareness of OWASP Top 10 and secure application development practices.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Exposure to frontend or backend performance optimization.

  

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering field.

jobs.description:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. * Experience delivering declarative solutions across multiple objects and integrated business processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to review configurations critically and recommend scalable, maintainable solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator credential.
* Experience designing complex Flow orchestration and reusable automation frameworks.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale Salesforce environments with multiple teams and stakeholder groups.

* Experience establishing configuration standards, governance controls, and technical-debt reduction initiatives.

Reporting to the Head of People Systems, the role provides functional leadership to the Functional Analyst team and is responsible for the design, configuration, optimisation, and support of People Systems.

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

jobs.title: Staff, AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

As the Staff,AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 18+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
