jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?  
  
Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Product Manager for SmartHub, our multi-channel e-commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.  
  
We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.  
  
As the Product Manager for SmartHub, you will be at the forefront of defining and executing this journey by identifying the opportunities, defining the product and deliver exceptional seller experiences. Your work will directly impact the growth and success of sellers leveraging Amazon SmartHub, enabling them to scale their business to new heights.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Understand seller problems to identify unmet needs and emerging trends in the e-commerce landscape.

  

* Monitor and analyze competitor activities and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and innovation.

  

* Translate seller insights and market opportunities into detailed product requirements and user stories for the engineering team.

  

* Collaborate with GTM, engineering, UX, support and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch.

  

* Analyze product performance data, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on the product based on customer feedback and business results.

  

* Conduct A/B testing and other experiments to optimize product features and improve key metrics.

  

* Develop and maintain product documentation, including user guides, training materials, and FAQs.

  
Required Skillset:  
  

* Proven ability to conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product strategy.

  

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and make data-driven decisions.

  

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams.

  

* Deep understanding of online product management principles, agile development methodologies, and A/B testing techniques.

  

* Bachelor's degree in a related field; MBA preferred with 3years of experience in product management

  
A day in the life  
You will start your day by reviewing the product and business metrics. You morning might involve speaking to a seller processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and other channels, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow. You will move fluidly between speaking to sellers, thinking of solutions, brainstorming with engineers, driving adoption and thinking strategy.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.  
  
SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce - high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.  
  
We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from a software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

* 3+ years of product management experience
* Experience managing technical products or online services

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
* Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
* Experience in creating PRFAQs, BRDs and other product documentation. Experience in leveraging AI for documentation, prototyping and business data analysis.

**About Karta**

Karta is building the AI operating system for customer-facing teams. We build AI agents that handle complex customer conversations across voice, chat and WhatsApp. Our agents don't just respond to questions—they understand context, reason through workflows and take action across business systems. We're building for high-volume, complex industries like fintech, where conversations require contextual understanding, objection handling, multilingual communication and reliable execution. Our ambition is to make AI conversations indistinguishable from great human interactions—not just in how they sound, but in how intelligently they work. We need a product leader who can turn this ambition into reality.

**Why This Role Exists**

Voice AI is moving beyond speech recognition and text-to-speech. The real challenge is building agents that can listen, understand, respond, interrupt, reason and act in real time. A great voice agent must know when to speak, when to listen, how to handle objections, when to retrieve context and how to recover when a conversation goes wrong. Your job is to own this experience end-to-end. You will work directly with customers, engineers and AI researchers to identify the biggest problems, design solutions and ship improvements that materially change agent performance.
  
You won't just build voice features. You'll build agents that perform better in real conversations.

Memory across turns and sessions

Contextual personalisation

Conversation recovery when agents misunderstand

Natural transitions between listening, reasoning and responding

The goal is to move beyond agents that sound human to agents that think and respond appropriately in human conversations.

Voice-specific evaluation frameworks

Automated conversation simulations

Golden evaluation datasets

Failure categorisation and root-cause analysis

Real-time monitoring and agent observability

Metrics across latency, resolution, CSAT and conversation quality

Shadow real customer conversations

Analyse human-agent performance

Translate customer pain into product requirements

Prioritise features based on business impact

Define success metrics and validate outcomes

Start with the problem, not the feature request.

Own the product lifecycle from idea to production.

Product strategy and roadmap

PRDs and feature specifications

UX and conversational flow design

Engineering and research prioritisation

Release quality and adoption

Feedback loops from customers and production data

You will work closely with engineering, AI/ML and GTM teams to ship quickly without compromising reliability.

**What We're Looking For**

**Voice AI experience:** Hands-on experience with conversational AI, speech systems, voice agents or real-time AI products.

**Technical depth:** Understand ASR, TTS, speech pipelines, latency, LLMs, tool calling and agent architectures.

**Product judgment:** Can distinguish a technically interesting feature from one that materially improves customer outcomes.

**Customer obsession:** Will listen to hundreds of conversations to understand what is actually going wrong.

**Execution intensity:** Can move from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution quickly.

**High agency:** Comfortable operating without a fully defined roadmap, process or team.

**Data-driven:** Comfortable designing evaluations, analysing failures and prioritising based on evidence.

We care more about what you've built and how you think than the title you held previously.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a feature factory PM role.

It is not a role where you simply write PRDs and hand them to engineering.

It is not limited to managing a speech API or improving a voice interface.

You will be expected to understand the technology, listen to actual conversations, investigate failures, make trade-offs and drive solutions into production.

International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager-Tech, Amazon Supply Chain Services
jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), which includes Multichannel Commerce Fulfillment (MCCF), lets merchants use Amazon’s fulfilment and logistics network to reach customers wherever they shop: their own websites, social commerce, other marketplaces and wholesale. Our vision is to enable every entrepreneur in the world to reach every customer in the world through every channel they can imagine. Through Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), Buy with Prime (BwP), Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD) and Warehousing & Logistics, merchants keep products in stock, ship faster and more reliably, and lower their costs. For over 20 years Amazon has helped small and medium-sized businesses grow on Amazon; ASCS is how we help merchants of every size grow beyond it.
  
  
As ASCS scales, how merchants find, choose and get more out of it matters as much as what it offers. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager–Technical (Sr. PMT) to shape how ASCS grows with merchants: understanding why merchants who would benefit are not yet using our services, building the products and platforms that change that, and proving what actually moves the business. You will pair strategic vision with hands-on execution, working across engineering, business, finance and data science teams to build products fundamental to Amazon’s future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
> Product strategy & direction: Continuously assess the needs of our customers and partners in defining and evolving the product and business strategy. Identify where ASCS services create the most value for merchants and translate those insights into a clear, differentiated product direction across marketing and pricing surfaces.
  
  
> Roadmap planning: Deliver world-class innovation in features, usability, and performance in a consistent release cadence. Be the internal and external authority for your program, driving value-based prioritisation from concept to launch to maximise ROI.
  
  
> Requirements definition: Develop comprehensive product plans incorporating merchant needs, competitive context, and business objectives. Produce high-quality requirements docs and manage scope to deliver key capabilities on time.
  
  
> Technical collaboration: Partner with engineering to craft BRDs, influence the design and architecture of technical solutions, and make informed trade-off decisions that balance merchant impact with implementation complexity.
  
  
> AI & productivity leverage: Apply AI tools to meaningfully accelerate product development from drafting and iterating on requirement document, merchant-facing messaging, to customer research, modelling pricing scenarios, and generating campaign briefs. You will actively identify where AI can compress timelines and improve output quality across the product lifecycle, and serve as a proponent of AI adoption within your cross-functional teams.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
> Collaborate with GTM, Sales, User Research, Tech, Finance, and Operations to define strategy, vision, and features for MCF and ASCS adoption.
  
  
> Own the product backlog and BRDs across marketing and pricing workstreams; prioritize and make feature trade-offs that maximize merchant adoption and ROI.
  
  
> Deliver products end-to-end across Engineering, Legal, Information Security, UX, and Finance from concept through launch.
  
  
> Design, launch, and iterate on lifecycle automation and targeted campaigns to engage and convert unmanaged merchants at scale.
  
  
> Communicate charter vision, roadmap, and business impact to senior leadership
  
  
**About The Team**
ASCS helps merchants of every size reach customers on any channel through Multi-Channel Fulfillment, Buy with Prime, Multi-Channel Distribution and Warehousing & Logistics. The ASCS Monetisation team owns how this business earns while keeping merchants’ trust. We set what merchants pay through rate cards, fees, discounts, incentives and negotiated pricing. We make merchants whole when inventory or orders are lost, damaged or returned. And we decide how merchants are invoiced and collected from, extending flexible payment terms without avoidable bad debt. Every decision must be calculated correctly, posted accurately, explained clearly and measured for real impact.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* 6+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?
  
  
Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Product Manager for SmartHub, our multi-channel e-commerce operations platform. We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.
  
  
As the Product Manager for SmartHub, you will be at the forefront of defining and executing this journey by identifying the opportunities, defining the product and deliver exceptional seller experiences. Your work will directly impact the growth and success of sellers leveraging Amazon SmartHub, enabling them to scale their business to new heights.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**About WisdomAI**
WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast-paced, early-stage startup, currently ~30 people and growing.
  
  
**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands-on function built for the age of AI-native product development. We are a build-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
  
  
At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
  
  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM-first, Design-first, or Dev-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.

**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

**Job Description**
We are looking for an ambitious, systems-thinking, and highly analytical Product Manager to take ownership of our foundational cash management, treasury, and settlement ecosystem. As our transaction volume scales, the complexity of moving money efficiently, securely, and reliably becomes paramount.
  
  
In this role, you will be the driving force behind the core systems that govern optimal liquidity, power seamless financial operations, and establish direct integrations with central payment networks. You will navigate complex regulatory and technical landscapes, starting with optimizing our daily liquidity and settlement operations. Over time, you will spearhead the evolution of this function from an operational backbone into a highly strategic, value-generating engine that optimizes our working capital and financial intelligence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Drive Core Treasury Platforms: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our treasury and liquidity management platforms, translating complex financial workflows into scalable, automated product architectures.
* Optimize Money Movement: Design and launch scalable products that automate fund flows, optimize merchant payouts, and ensure seamless money movement across our internal and external ecosystems.
* Build for System Resilience: Develop highly fault-tolerant platform capabilities that guarantee business continuity, intelligent transaction routing, and systemic resilience against external network or banking outages.
* Enable Financial Intelligence: Create product features and tools that empower our finance and treasury teams with advanced cash flow forecasting, real-time visibility, and strategic capital optimization.
* Manage Complex Integrations: Lead the product strategy for secure and robust API integrations with key financial networks and banking partners to expand our foundational operational capabilities.
* Embed Compliance & Controls: Ensure all treasury products are built with a compliance-first mindset, incorporating automated reconciliation, rigorous financial controls, and seamless auditability.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2 to 4 years of proven experience in Product Management, successfully taking complex, backend-heavy products from conception to launch.
* Domain Preference: Prior experience in Fintech, Banking, Payments, or building highly scalable backend platform products is highly preferred (though not a strict requirement for a fast learner with strong fundamentals).
* Technical Acumen: Ability to deeply understand and orchestrate complex transaction flows, messaging architectures, and secure API integrations between internal ledgers and external financial institutions.
* Analytical Rigor: Exceptional data-driven problem-solving skills. You should be comfortable navigating complex financial workflows, large-scale reconciliations, and designing solutions for intricate edge cases.
* Strategic Execution: A strong bias for action with the ability to balance immediate operational requirements with long-term, highly scalable platform architecture.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You will need to collaborate seamlessly with and influence engineering, finance, treasury operations, and legal/compliance teams.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

**The Data Governance Manager owns the policies, standards, and stewardship model that keep data — real estate, consumer, and operational — accurate, compliant, and trustworthy for use across the business. This role sits within Technology and partners closely with Compliance, Enterprise Risk, and the data platform team to operationalize governance across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and MongoDB environments. A defining requirement of this role is deep, hands-on fluency in real estate data (MLS, public record, tax assessor, deed/title) alongside other third-party data domains (demographics, geolocation).**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Define, publish, and maintain enterprise data governance policies, standards, and a data stewardship model covering ownership, quality, classification, and lifecycle management**
* Build and maintain the enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage maps in Microsoft Purview across source systems, Azure data stores, Fabric workspaces, and MongoDB collections
* **Establish and monitor data quality rules, remediation workflows, and quality scorecards for critical data domains, with real estate and third-party data as top priorities**
* **Classify and label sensitive data** (PII, consumer, regulated real estate data) and enforce access controls and data loss prevention policies in partnership with Security and Compliance
* Chair a cross-functional data governance council with representation from Technology, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, and business data owners; drive adoption of governance policy across the organization
* Own governance requirements for third-party and vendor data agreements, including MLS licensing terms, public record data provider contracts, and demographic/geolocation data licenses
* Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure data handling practices meet real estate industry regulations, consumer privacy law (e.g., CCPA/CPRA, GLBA, FCRA), and MLS/IDX rules
* Define and track data governance KPIs and maturity metrics; report governance posture and risk to executive leadership
* Support data platform initiatives (Customer 360, enterprise data lake, AI/ML programs) by ensuring underlying data meets governance and quality bars before use
* Provide governance guidance and training to data stewards, engineers, and analysts across the technology organization

**Real Estate Data Domain Expertise**

This role requires working knowledge of real estate data sources and the compliance obligations attached to them, including:

* MLS data: licensing and usage terms, IDX/VOW display rules, field-level restrictions, data syndication agreements, and MLS Grid or comparable aggregation standards
* Public record data: county assessor, tax roll, deed/title, foreclosure, and lien data — governing provenance, refresh cadence, accuracy validation, and jurisdictional variance across counties and states
* Valuation and transaction data: automated valuation model (AVM) inputs/outputs, comparable sales data, and title/escrow data, with attention to accuracy and defensibility given downstream business and consumer use
* Regulatory context: familiarity with real estate industry bodies and standards (NAR, MLS Grid, RESO Data Dictionary) and how they shape data usage rights and audit requirements
* Candidates should be able to speak to the governance challenges unique to real estate data — fragmented sourcing, inconsistent standards across MLSs and counties, and strict licensing terms — and to translate them into practical governance controls.

**Other Data Domain Expertise**

Beyond real estate, this role governs a range of third-party and derived data used across the business:

* Demographics: syndicated and census-derived consumer demographic data, including governance of aggregation level, licensing restrictions, and appropriate use in modeling and targeting
* Geolocation and geospatial data: geocoding accuracy, parcel and boundary data, coordinate reference standards, and spatial data quality across mapping and location-based use cases
* Third-party and vendor data generally: tracking usage rights, contractual restrictions, refresh obligations, and lineage from ingestion through downstream consumption, ensuring vendor data is cataloged and classified to the same standard as internally generated data

* **Microsoft Purview:** hands-on experience configuring data catalog scans, classification and sensitivity labels, business glossary, data lineage, DLP policies, and compliance/insider risk features across hybrid data estates
* Microsoft Azure: governance of data across Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure SQL, including access control (RBAC/ABAC), encryption, and monitoring
* **Microsoft Fabric:** governance within OneLake, lakehouses, pipelines, and semantic models, including domain and workspace-level governance and integration with Purview's unified catalog
* MongoDB: schema and metadata governance for document/NoSQL stores, including collection-level classification, indexing standards, and integration of MongoDB sources into the broader catalog and lineage picture
* Ability to design governance controls that work consistently across this mixed relational/lakehouse/NoSQL ecosystem, rather than treating each platform in isolation

Serve as a senior consultant specializing in functional testing and user acceptance testing coordination for complex order to cash credit management solutions in a hybrid work model. Collaborate with cross functional teams to refine user stories manage test repositories and ensure stable basic information systems that support secure and efficient cards and payments operations for global stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Drive end to end functional testing cycles by designing detailed test scenarios and executing test cases that validate critical order to cash credit management workflows across integrated applications.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing by planning timelines aligning stakeholders and ensuring that business users can validate solutions against documented user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Analyze functional requirements and user stories to identify test coverage gaps clarify ambiguities with product owners and confirm that business rules for credit management are fully validated.
* Maintain structured test repositories by organizing test cases test data and execution evidence so that audit readiness and traceability from requirements to results are consistently achieved.
* Collaborate with developers business analysts and operations teams to triage defects perform impact analysis and confirm that fixes are verified in functional testing and regression cycles.
* Document clear defect descriptions reproducible steps and impact statements so that delivery teams can quickly understand root causes and prioritize remediation for production stability.
* Validate order to cash basic information system configurations by testing reference data credit limits and customer master attributes that influence downstream billing and collections processes.
* Engage with business stakeholders to refine user stories by translating operational needs into testable acceptance criteria that support cards and payments scenarios and related credit decisions.
* Support data validation activities by comparing system outputs against source records and reference rules to ensure accurate balances limits and transaction statuses in non production environments.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to test processes repository structures and coordination practices that increase product quality and delivery predictability.
* Prepare concise test progress reports and summary dashboards that highlight execution status defect trends and risk areas so that project sponsors can make informed release decisions.
* Ensure that all testing activities comply with internal quality standards and external regulations relevant to financial services and payments processing environments.
* Work effectively within a hybrid model by coordinating onsite and remote collaborators ensuring smooth communication across time zones during day shifts without travel obligations.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive practical experience in functional testing for complex enterprise systems with at least seven years of hands on design execution and defect management responsibilities.
* Show strong proficiency in coordinating user acceptance testing by engaging business users clarifying expectations and guiding them through structured test cycles for order to cash processes.
* Exhibit proven capability in writing and refining user stories in partnership with product owners while defining clear acceptance criteria that align with business outcomes and compliance needs.
* Apply consistent repository management practices using test management or versioning tools to structure artifacts test cases and evidence for scalable reuse across multiple releases.
* Display solid knowledge of order to cash credit management concepts including credit limits risk assessment inputs and exception handling as they apply to enterprise information systems.
* Bring working exposure to order to cash basic information systems including core reference data customer hierarchies and configuration elements that drive credit and billing logic.
* Offer beneficial domain understanding in cards and payments such as transaction life cycles authorization flows and settlement considerations that influence testing priorities and risk focus.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non technical stakeholders in a hybrid environment while collaborating during daytime schedules and adapting to global project expectations.

jobs.description:
Scrum Master – IntegroLending

Company

Aurionpro Solutions Limited – Integro Lending Suite

Location

Noida, India – [On-site]

Experience

7–10 years total; 3+ years as a full-time Scrum Master

Team

2–3 Scrum teams (15–25 engineers) across backend, frontend and integrations

Reports to

[Program Manager]

Employment type

Full-time, permanent

About the team and the role

IntegroLending is Aurionpro's end-to-end retail lending platform for banks and NBFCs. It covers origination, loan servicing, collections and closure. The team builds Java microservices and Angular apps in a single GitLab repository, plus third-party integrations.

As Scrum Master, you will help these teams deliver predictably while the platform goes through a major modernisation. You will run the Scrum process, remove blockers, manage dependencies between teams and keep delivery visible to stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

Run sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives for 2–3 Scrum teams, and keep them focused and time-boxed.

Work with the Product Owner to keep the backlog refined, prioritised and ready, with clear acceptance criteria and a Definition of Ready and Done.

Remove blockers quickly, including environment, access and third-party sandbox issues with bureau, KYC and payment partners.

Coordinate dependencies across backend, frontend and integration teams, and with QA, DevOps and implementation teams.

Track and report velocity, burndown, cycle time and release readiness in JIRA and GitLab, and flag risks early.

Support release planning and the move through SIT, UAT and production with the Technical Lead.

Make sure work meets quality gates (code review, CI pipeline, test coverage) before it counts as done.

Coach the team on Agile practices, story splitting and estimation, and drive real improvements from retrospectives.

Shield the team from unplanned work and handle scope changes through the Product Owner.

Skills

**Must have**

3+ years as a dedicated Scrum Master for software teams of 8 or more engineers.

Strong knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, and of scaling across several teams (Scrum of Scrums, SAFe or similar).

Hands-on with JIRA (boards, workflows, dashboards) and Confluence; familiar with GitLab issues, merge requests and pipelines.

Enough technical background to follow discussions on microservices, APIs, CI/CD and environments.

Excellent facilitation, communication and conflict-resolution skills.

Experience reporting delivery status and risks to senior management and clients.

**Good to have**

Delivery experience in BFSI, ideally lending (LOS/LMS) for Indian banks or NBFCs.

Experience with products that have client implementations, UAT and go-live phases.

Experience working with third-party vendors and integration partners.

Experience with a hybrid model (phase gates combined with Agile sprints).

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

Certification: CSM, PSM I/II or SAFe Scrum Master (required); PMI-ACP or ICP-ACC is a plus.

What we offer

A central role on a lending platform used by banks and NBFCs across India.

The chance to shape how a large engineering team works during a major modernisation.
